sections.title: Visual Descriptions of Images
sections.summary: The section consists of a series of images with accompanying audio descriptions. Each image shows a person, later revealed to be a man with short hair and glasses, in various outdoor settings. The images depict the man in relaxed postures, smiling, and taking selfies.

visual_cues.image_description: A man with short hair and glasses lying on their side outdoors.
visual_cues.gestures: Smiling broadly at the camera and looking directly into it.
visual_cues.outfit: Wearing a gray shirt with black glasses.

visual_cues.image_description: A person taking a selfie, smiling warmly at the camera.
visual_cues.gestures: Resting an arm on a surface that could be a railing or fence.
visual_cues.outfit: Wearing a gray shirt and black glasses.

visual_cues.image_description: A man with a bald head and glasses leaning on something, likely a table.
visual_cues.gestures: Smiling broadly as he holds his camera phone to take a selfie.
visual_cues.outfit: Wearing a white t-shirt and having a beard and mustache.

visual_cues.image_description: A person taking a selfie with their arm resting on something out of focus.
visual_cues.gestures: Gesturing towards something out of frame with their right hand.
visual_cues.outfit: Wearing a white shirt and a gray baseball cap.

verbal_cues.phrases: Taking selfies, enjoying the moment, smiling broadly.
verbal_cues.topics: Outdoor settings, relaxed postures, everyday moments captured in images.
